thread:
evan: Quick sync — Acme Health just asked for SOC 2 + ISO artifacts for the prod POC, plus a pen-test sign-off letter. They also want a 'privacy holdback' for customer-specific files (redaction) before we upload to their dataroom. Can we deliver all this within 3 business days? cc @jamal @maria

jamal: 3 days is tight. Do they want us to upload artifacts to their Dataroom or to a shared S3 presigned link? That affects ops time.

maria: Presigned S3 is easiest from our side. We can create time-limited presigned POSTs and a CSV manifest. Retention window 7 days by default — we can shorten if legal requires.

ben: Heads-up: if the POC needs dedicated capacity or white-glove tenant isolation, that changes pricing. Olivia, did Acme ask about dedicated nodes?

olivia: They mentioned "predictable throughput" and are evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted. For the compliance pack they want cost impact summarized. Can someone add a quick delta (est monthly) for a small Dedicated pool?

ben: ballpark: small Dedicated (2x A100 equiv) ≈ $Xk/mo additional + one-time provisioning ~2 weeks. If they need on-prem or VPC networking add integration hours.

maria: For artifacts I can produce: SOC 2 report index, control mapping, ISO27001 scope doc, network diagram (sanitized). I need a list of which assets they consider "customer-specific" so I can redact.

sarah-legal: We can issue the pen-test attestation letter. Our standard approach: an attestation that a third-party pentest was performed on X date with summary findings (no PII included). For redaction/holdback: we require either (a) a mutual NDA addendum that permits redaction or (b) a redaction checklist from Acme listing fields to withhold. We can also provide a redacted artifact plus a verified-scan summary confirming no residual secrets.

olivia: I'll ask Acme to send the redaction list. Suggest they mark any sample logs/URIs as "holdback".

riley: If we do presigned S3, here's a small snippet we use to generate a 48h upload link (feel free to paste to Acme):
```python
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_post('redwood-evidence', 'acme_poc/1745.zip', ExpiresIn=172800)
print(url)
```
We can set Content-MD5 and require AES256 server-side encryption.

acme-support-bot: Reminder: create upload bucket path with strict ACLs and object lifecycle -> auto-delete 7d.

evan: Perfect. Action items: (1) Olivia: request redaction checklist + confirm whether they need Dedicated quote (2) Maria: prepare redacted SOC control map + sanitized network diagram (3) Sarah: draft pen-test attestation template we can send to Acme for signature (4) Ben: include pricing delta and provisioning ETA if Dedicated requested (5) Riley/infra: presigned link + lifecycle policy.

jamal: Timeline check — infra needs ~6 business hours to stand up bucket and presigned endpoint once we have exact file list. Maria needs ~1 business day to run redactions once we have the holdback list. Legal needs ~1 business day to produce the attestation letter. Seems feasible in 3 business days if Acme sends the redaction list now.

olivia: I'll ping them now. sending:
> Hi — can you share the exact list of artifact files/fields you want redacted for the Dataroom, and confirm whether you prefer us to upload to your dataroom or use a presigned S3 link? We also want to confirm whether you need Dedicated capacity pricing for the POC.

olivia: they replied: "Prefer presigned link. Will provide redaction list by EOD. Need Dedicated quote for evaluation but POC can start on Hosted."

maria: Good — I'll start preparing the sanitized diagram and control map (no IPs, remove internal hostnames).

sarah-legal: Drafting pen-test letter now. I'll include the following language snippet for attestation and a redaction appendix option:
```
We attest that Redwood Inference engaged a qualified third-party security assessor who completed a penetration test on <DATE>. The assessment methodology, scope, and high-level findings are summarized herein. Detailed exploit data and customer-specific logs are redacted as requested; Redwood can provide a redaction appendix and a signed statement confirming no customer secrets are retained in the shared artifacts.
```

riley: Once we get the manifest from Maria + redaction list I'll create the presigned POSTs and share upload URLs. I will enforce SSE and restrict uploads to the path `acme-poc/<upload-id>/`.

ben: If they later require Dedicated for SLA reasons we'll need 2 weeks lead time for provisioning. I'll prepare a short pricing delta doc and attach it to the pack.

evan: Great. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done so I can assemble the evidence bundle?

maria: :white_check_mark: starting now, will share sanitized PDFs by EOD tomorrow.

sarah-legal: :white_check_mark: I will DM the draft to Olivia and Evan in ~4 hours.

riley: :white_check_mark: infra hooks ready; will generate links after manifest.

ben: :white_check_mark: pricing doc drafted, dropping in this thread in ~2h.

olivia: ack — updating Acme and will share their redaction CSV when received.

evan: Thanks team. If anything blocks, drop it here or ping me.

acme-support-bot: Upload bucket created: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc-temp-179999-0001 — lifecycle 7d, SSE required, presigned tokens expire 48h.
